source_full_text: And he took her down into the cellar and showed her the same two great jars that he had showed Lizina. In which of these shall I dip you he asked and she made haste to answer in the liquid gold for she was no more modest than she was good and kind. Father Gatto's yellow eyes darted fire.

reference_text: 他带她走进地窖，给她看那两个他曾经给莉齐娜看过的巨大陶罐。他问道：“我该把你浸在哪一个罐子里呢？”她急忙回答：“在那液态的金子里面。”因为她不像她看起来那样羞怯，反而既善良又和蔼。加托神父的黄眼睛顿时迸发出怒火。
